SSRF policy rejects an IPv4 loopback address embedded in the well-known NAT64 prefix

```csharp title="C#"
using System;
using System.Text.Json;
using Crawlberg;

var ConfigOptions = new JsonSerializerOptions { PropertyNameCaseInsensitive = true };
try
{
var engineConfig = JsonSerializer.Deserialize<CrawlConfig>("{\"ssrf\":{\"deny_private\":true},\"ssrf_deny_private_explicit\":true}", ConfigOptions)!;
var engine = CrawlbergConverter.CreateEngine(engineConfig);
var url = "http://[64:ff9b::7f00:1]/";
var result = await CrawlbergConverter.ScrapeAsync(engine, url);
}
catch (Exception error)
{
    Console.Error.WriteLine($"{error.GetType().Name}: {error.Message}");
}
```
